pr_title: [Performance] remove D2H sync in QLIMetadata builder for DSA_CP
source_quote:
gemini (662): Update the argument name to `max_seqlen_k` to match the updated parameter name in `_build_qli_metadata` to avoid a `NameError` at runtime.
> gemini (871): In `_build_qli_metadata`, the variable `max_seqlen_k` is used inside the method (at line 892) but it is not defined because the local definition was removed and the parameter was named `max_seqlen` instead. This will cause a `NameError` at runtime. Please rename the parameter `max_seqlen` to `max_seqlen_k` to match its usage inside the method.
> codex (871): When DSA context parallelism uses `compressor_ratio == 4`... this method now receives the key length as `max_seqlen`, but the operator call still references `max_seqlen_k`; the prior local definition of that name was deleted. Metadata construction therefore raises `NameError` before the QLI operator can run. Use the new `max_seqlen` parameter for `max_seqlen_k`.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha d74d726 体现修改

rule.description: 当重命名函数参数或变量时，必须同步更新函数体内所有引用该名称的位置，否则会导致 `NameError` 等运行时错误。特别是当移除局部变量定义、改为参数传入时，需检查 operator 调用中的 kwarg 是否仍引用旧变量名。
checkpoints: 重命名参数后，检查函数体内是否还有旧变量名的引用（尤其 kwarg 传值 `old_name=old_name`）
移除局部变量定义改为参数传入时，确认参数名与函数体内使用的变量名一致
注意 kwarg 形式 `param=value` 中 `value` 部分是否引用了不存在的变量
检查所有调用点是否同步更新了参数名

def _build_qli_metadata(self, query_start_loc, seq_lens, seq_lens_q, num_reqs):
        """Build QLI metadata for quantized lightning indexer."""
        if self.compressor_ratio != 4:
            return None
        # 重构移除了内部的 D2H 同步:
        # max_seqlen_k = max(1, int(seq_lens.max().item()))  ← 已删除
        # 但未将 max_seqlen_k 作为参数传入
        ...
        metadata = torch.ops._C_ascend.npu_vllm_quant_lightning_indexer_metadata(
            query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
            seq_lens=seq_lens,
            num_reqs=num_reqs,
            max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q,
            max_seqlen_k=max_seqlen_k,  # ❌ NameError: max_seqlen_k 未定义
            compressor_ratio=self.compressor_ratio,
        )
        return metadata

            seq_lens=seq_lens,
            num_reqs=num_reqs,
            max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q,
            max_seqlen_k=max_seqlen,  # ✅ 使用传入的 max_seqlen 参数
            compressor_ratio=self.compressor_ratio,
        )
        return metadata
